Description: &lt;h3&gt;LyricFlash is a small desk device that on button press; listens to the music playing around you, identifies the song, and shows the lyrics on a round AMOLED touch screen. When no song is playing, it works as a clock with custom clock faces.&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;h3&gt;This is the printable enclosure for the Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75 board.&amp;nbsp;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;h3&gt;The firmware is open source and builds on GitHub: &lt;a target=&amp;quot;_blank&amp;quot; rel=&amp;quot;noopener noreferrer&amp;quot; href=&amp;quot;https://github.com/skiiirt1983/LyricFlash&amp;quot;&gt;https://github.com/skiiirt1983/LyricFlash&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;WHAT IT DOES:&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e6fff4e060c126375afc1c79b8388ae2d&amp;quot;&gt;Identifies songs on demand using AudD (you add your own free AudD API key).&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e4e9b5737db75421eb0ee51457a7db9ab&amp;quot;&gt;Looks up time-synced lyrics from LRCLIB.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e1be4233490ff5ebace220e4eee09a527&amp;quot;&gt;Clock mode with several clock fonts/colors, set from a web page on the device. (Swipe Right on the Device)&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e1fd047dc287ff077c91998efe8b392d9&amp;quot;&gt;Optional weather on the clock face (Swipe up from the Clock Face)&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e32656c8a3450b9f91abbcb5ce87cfe5b&amp;quot;&gt;Over-the-air updates straight from GitHub builds, so there is no cable needed after the first flash.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;WHAT YOU NEED:&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;ecfe08e67c26eec1a5e30fc0bca291a39&amp;quot;&gt;Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.75 (SKU 31261)&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e97ee4d153e1f62d953691cf3b667ea44&amp;quot;&gt;Lithium Polymer battery 3.7V 2000 mAh - &lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Size: 10 mm x 34 mm x 54 mm - JST MX1.25 CONNECTOR&amp;nbsp;&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e428d632ebb5df86ece00c8e385f6ed65&amp;quot;&gt;JST MX1.25 mm soft silicone cable - enough for 2 lengths inside the enclosure.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e5f8ee7eb699e4044730300c4a48e1665&amp;quot;&gt;JST MX1.25 mm 2 Pin Connector (Or re-use the one from the battery)&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e7e70251f0798c330e2cf7d7a07279e0f&amp;quot;&gt;3x M2x3 Machine Screws to attach the carrier to the Waveshare&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e7487ba3aac5a2dd87e1b8025a37c826f&amp;quot;&gt;2 M2.5x6 (Standard Bambu Size)&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e99aeb04a417ad9da7c0c9a5859b554ab&amp;quot;&gt;8 4x2 N52 Magnets&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e188296f5c48924d884765a18c432b9dd&amp;quot;&gt;USB-C Data Cable&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e2bbbc165dde9fa99913e00db6c16e761&amp;quot;&gt;Superglue for magnets that are not tight enough.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e486971c693155bddfe825276fe0ec050&amp;quot;&gt;A free &lt;a target=&amp;quot;_blank&amp;quot; rel=&amp;quot;noopener noreferrer&amp;quot; href=&amp;quot;https://dashboard.audd.io/signup&amp;quot;&gt;AudD API key&lt;/a&gt; for song recognition&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e051c155c0906c6b3942430aa45f6d440&amp;quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;PRINTING:&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;ul&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;ed7382010afcce7a34811c48c0e5177a9&amp;quot;&gt;Printer and material: Tested on Bambu Lab P2S, using Bambu Lab PLA Metal, Bambu Lab PETG Matte&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;ea97453edf3e949fe817ee2dc9032538e&amp;quot;&gt;Layer height: 0.2mm, walls: 4, infill: 15% - Gyroid/Monotonic&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;ec37c0e19322778a0ec29626bcebb339e&amp;quot;&gt;Supports: Yes - Top USB Port ONLY&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e53cbbdc120f2342f137db436a018986f&amp;quot;&gt;Skirt Loop: 1x: &amp;nbsp;For highest quality first layer!&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e74625cc9f5b15a938d7472074ba59a33&amp;quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Parts:&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;Top Shell, Carrier Plate - PLA,&amp;nbsp;7g - Shell, 2g-Carrier&lt;br&gt;Base, Carrier Plate - PETG - Carrier plate in PETG is optional. 56g per base + 2g Carrier&lt;br&gt;Roughly 63g Total Material.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p style=&amp;quot;text-align:center;&amp;quot;&gt;•••&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp; &amp;nbsp; *** NOTE - THE MAGNET HOLES WERE DESIGNED FOR PLA/PETG - IF YOU DEVIATE, THE MAGNETS MAY NOT FIT&amp;nbsp;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p style=&amp;quot;text-align:center;&amp;quot;&gt;•••&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p style=&amp;quot;text-align:center;&amp;quot;&gt;I have uploaded a PLA Base profile. &amp;nbsp;Resized holes to fit PLA&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p style=&amp;quot;text-align:center;&amp;quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;ASSEMBLY:&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;ol&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;ea9ff45cb602d2e587aa100c52d988177&amp;quot;&gt;Seat the Waveshare in the carrier plate in the base. The USB-C port lines up with the opening in the left wall. - Markings on the carrier plate exist to ensure correct positioning.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e34e6b6ac96453a4215cb9d785684a4cc&amp;quot;&gt;Install magnets with attracting sides facing each other - may require glue.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e608eed6af8acb2ca3193d102b8d6e32c&amp;quot;&gt;Fit the Waveshare onto the base aligning the new mounting hole locations.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;ee5e5047f86d13ea501c6fb4de9bdf672&amp;quot;&gt;Fit the front over the base.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e88d6515ab45dd9a82a9030c30b7ab50a&amp;quot;&gt;The top of the clock points toward the back-centre tab of the carrier plate.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ol&gt;&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;FIRMWARE SETUP:&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;ol&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e68e382bf15d83656c2ed47b18648bbf8&amp;quot;&gt;Go to the &lt;a target=&amp;quot;_blank&amp;quot; rel=&amp;quot;noopener noreferrer&amp;quot; href=&amp;quot;https://github.com/skiiirt1983/LyricFlash/releases&amp;quot;&gt;Releases&lt;/a&gt; Page on Github and download the FULL-USB Install bin.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;ed82dc0b13fc3af974680653f7ebcebb9&amp;quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;VERY IMPORTANT &lt;/u&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;on &lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Chrome/Edge&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/strong&gt; go to &lt;a target=&amp;quot;_blank&amp;quot; rel=&amp;quot;noopener noreferrer&amp;quot; href=&amp;quot;https://skiiirt1983.github.io/LyricFlash/&amp;quot;&gt;LyricFlash Web Flashing Tool&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e6485ea1ce32277f1964db1902e1cd32b&amp;quot;&gt;Plug the Waveshare into your PC using a &lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;DATA&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/strong&gt; USB cable (Listen for the device recognition sound in windows) Not all usb cables are data cables&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;efdef1d785cd155e2114194fa4c703a1b&amp;quot;&gt;Flash the latest build from the downloaded file. &amp;nbsp;&lt;span class=&amp;quot;d-flex flex-items-start text-bold&amp;quot;&gt;LyricFlash-1.X.X-FULL-USB.bin&lt;/span&gt;&lt;span class=&amp;quot;d-flex flex-items-start&amp;quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e99a9c838a7cbe5a8fcafda75983c50ea&amp;quot;&gt;Unplug from PC - Perform Manual Hard-Reset after firmware has installed and device reset.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e100077a94a9c3bc6db6479bffdb0e3b2&amp;quot;&gt;Connect to the device&amp;apos;s Wi-Fi Setup-Network (2.5ghz - &amp;quot;LyricFlash-Setup&amp;quot;) - You can setup WIFI on the device or in the WebUI.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e9b957864901cca74471e48cce898c4cd&amp;quot;&gt;Open the device&amp;apos;s settings page in a browser to enter your WIFI credentials. Go to the device settings; add your AudD key.&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ol&gt;&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;• STATUS •&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;The firmware is still in active development and may have rough edges. Updates arrive over the air.&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p&gt;Device is 100% Functional and thoroughly tested.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;Credits: Fonts are open source (see the firmware repo for credits). Lyrics from LRCLIB, song recognition by AudD, weather from Open-Meteo.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;100% AI Generated.&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;100% Human Tested and tested and tested :)&lt;/p&gt;

ProfileDescription: &lt;ul&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;eb031f062526cbbb1cf102aa9736518bb&amp;quot;&gt;Printer and material: Tested on Bambu Lab P2S, using Bambu Lab PLA Metal, Bambu Lab PETG Matte&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;e31e95a94c10ae4013eacb9bfd1988b8a&amp;quot;&gt;Layer height: 0.2mm, walls: 4, infill: 15% - Gyroid/Monotonic&lt;/li&gt;&lt;li class=&amp;quot;ck-list-marker-bold&amp;quot; data-list-item-id=&amp;quot;eadb7643f6bff1e6a8206922452e6e4b3&amp;quot;&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Supports: Yes - Top USB Port ONLY&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;/li&gt;&lt;/ul&gt;&lt;p&gt;I have manually painted the underside of the USB Port at the top. &amp;nbsp;It can be ugly if you don&amp;apos;t. &amp;nbsp;I have the settings adjusted for easy removal. &amp;nbsp;If you alter the file you may need to re-enable painted supports and paint them yourself. &amp;nbsp;The slicer has no warnings about overhangs so it will print without&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Parts:&amp;nbsp;&lt;/u&gt;&lt;/strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Top Shell, Carrier Plate - PLA,&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;Base, Carrier Plate - PETG - Carrier plate in PETG is optional.&lt;/p&gt;
Title: LyricFlash – Pocket Lyrics Display Enclosure for Waveshare ESP32-S3 AMOLED
